MonitoringProgramDescription: The vertical extinction coefficient must be less than 0.08 per meter when measured at any depth below the first meter (California and Nevada state standard).
MonitoringApproach: VEC is measured at the Lake Tahoe Index Station at least 24 times annually and at least 12 times annually at the mid-lake station. VEC is measured by lowering a submersible photometer down through the water column.

Partners.OrganizationName: UC Davis Tahoe Environmental Research Center

measures.title: Vertical extinction coefficient
measures.sub: Annual average light extinction at the Lake Tahoe Index Station, per meter, with one standard deviation above and below. Higher values mean less clear water.
